main_text.p: צְבִיאָה Ch. Ornatus, ornamétum. Hebr. צְבִי. Plur.cum Aff. זִיתְ צְבִיאָתָהָא Ornamenta sua, Esth. 2.9. in Targ. sec. & v.12. יוֹמָהָא דְצִיבָתְהוֹן Dies mundationis ipsorum.
צִבְחַ צְבֵר Ch. Modicum, pauculum, pauxillum, paululum, paulisper.
צְבַּע Ch. & Syr. Tingere, intingere, immergere, lavare, abluere: Item Sortiri, Sortem projicere, Esth. 3.7. in T. sec. & 9.24. Pahel צַבַּע Idem. Ithpah. אִצְטַבַּע Intingi, ablui.
צִבְעִין Ch. Color, Tinctura: Versicolor, coloratum. Plur. צִבְעוֹנִין & צִבְעַנִין Jerem. 4.30.
צַבַּע Ch. Intinctum, coloratum: Coccineum, צַבַּע זְהוֹרִי Coccineum, Dibaphum, Hebr. תּוֹלַעַת הַשָּׁנִי, Exo. 39.3.
אִצְבַּע, אִצְבָּא Ch. Digitus. Plur. masc. אִצְבְּעִין, & foemin. אִצְבְּעָתָא אִצְבָּעָן.
כַּצְבָּן Syr. Idem. Sic etiam videtur sumendum illud, דְּלִית לְהוֹן צִיבְעָא יִתִירָא Quibus non est digitus, unguis redundans, seu longus, Levit. 11.13. in Jonath. Plur. כְּצַבָּן.
צְבַךְ Ch. Congesit, collegit, comportavit, congregavit, coacervavit. Pahel צַבַּר Idem.
צִבַּת כַּצָּבַּא Syr. Ornare, exornare. Ethp. אִתְכַּצְּבַּא Ornari, ornare se.

page.notes: Hebrew and Aramaic script is rendered approximately; several vocalised forms and superscript marks are doubtful. Letters in the Syriac entries are uncertain.
